candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Design purpose does not create a category mismatch with train.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A passenger train is defined as a train used to carry passengers, so the subclass is a direct genus-species specialization.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Arrival need not be completed, but that does not affect processhood.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as train travel along a railway, and BFO_0000015 is process, so the occurrent placement matches.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: A plan-specification class would be tighter, but information content entity remains a valid superclass.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The plan is defined as an information content entity specifying a journey and explicitly not the travel process, matching IAO_0000030.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Dependence on a bearer is expected for a role and is not collapsed by this axiom.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a role realized by rail-journey participation and not as a person, matching BFO_0000023.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Probable role-versus-agent category error unless that parent is independently a role; not equivalent to the BFO role parent.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The same child is a role and expressly not a person, while the parent is labeled passenger in an agent ontology, which ordinarily denotes the bearer.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: The wording says the entity is a reservation rather than information about one; sound only if the parent is itself informational.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Rail reservation information is a domain specialization of reservation information, and both sides are framed as information.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Blocking design issue: unsafe if parent ticket is or includes an information content entity. Source left unchanged.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A rail ticket is intuitively a ticket, but the child is fixed as a material information bearer while ticket-as-bearer versus digital information is unresolved.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: A station-as-place could instead be a BFO site, which is immaterial; that is not what this definition asserts.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The definition treats the station as a material aggregate of facilities, structures, and infrastructure, fitting BFO material entity.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Object versus object aggregate is finer-grained and does not undermine material-entity membership.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A train of one or more rail vehicles is a material entity, so BFO_0000040 is an appropriate superclass.

method: 70% held-out cosine + 30% LLM only when held-out evidence exists; no score fabricated for cold-start/in-training candidate links
note: Cosine is not logical validity. Separate OWL reasoner and ticket-information scope review remain mandatory.
